title: Glomerular and tubular disorders: nephrotic, nephritic and RTA

steps.tx: **Nephrotic** (**protein over 40 mg per metre square hour**, **albumin under 2.5**, **edema** periorbital, **hyperlipidaemia**; **minimal change** commonest steroid sensitive, **FSGS** resistant, **membranous** rare; **steroids prednisolone 2 mg per kg**, **relapse** upper respiratory, **levamisole cyclophosphamide** frequent) with **complications** (**peritonitis** SBP vaccines, **thrombosis** renal vein, **hypovolaemia**) watches; **biopsy** (steroid resistant, under 1 over 12, haematuria) selects. Protein dips.

Latencies link throats.
